'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Steve Skilton LS Let The Wookiee Win (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Skilton]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Let The Wookiee Win (V) (Virtual Block 6)|Let The Wookiee Win (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
